column1: # The US map from macOS virtual key codes (kVK_*) to Android KeyEvent key codes (input.md §5.2
# Source of the kVK_* values: HIToolbox Events.h of the macOS SDK 27.0 in Xcode 27.0.
# Source of the KEYCODE_* values: android.view.KeyEvent of the API 37 android.jar; the same values are in android-api37-keycodes.txt.
# Keys that are not forwarded in key mode: Command (both sides)
# The Escape row maps to BACK. With input.escapeKey = escape
